Question figure. Central S; O above (2 parallel vertical lines), O lower-left (1 line), O lower-right (1 line). S has 1 lone pair directly below it, between the two lower O atoms. Upper O: 2 lone pairs at upper-left and upper-right. Lower-left O: 3 lone pairs (left, below, upper-left). Lower-right O: 3 lone pairs (right, below, upper-right). No charges, no brackets.
